component: UMa LOS and NLOS path loss
equation: PL_LOS = 28 + 22 log10(d3D) + 20 log10(fc) before breakpoint; PL_NLOS = max(PL_LOS, 13.54 + 39.08 log10(d3D) + 20 log10(fc) - 0.6(hUT-1.5))
parameter_domain: 0.5-100 GHz; d2D >= 10 m; hBS=25 m; hUT=1.5 m in this study
deviation: LOS state is sampled externally by the scenario generator; spatial consistency and full fast-fading clusters are custom/out of scope.
external_crosscheck: LLSim5G comparison harness defined; frozen external output not yet present

equation: PL_basic = FSPL(d3D, fc) + explicitly supplied clutter loss

deviation: Only the basic path-loss component is attributed to TR 38.811. Mobility, random fading, outage, interference, MCS, and KPI mapping are separately documented custom components.
